subject: Thank you after Saturday's session
text:
Hello,

I wanted to send a brief note after last Saturday's session, especially after the cancellation of the earlier service left me arriving much later than expected. It was kind of you to keep my notes and materials waiting for me at the desk, and I am grateful for the quiet way you handled the extra confusion in front of everyone. The route was disrupted for a time, and by the time I reached the venue the schedule had shifted without much warning. You seemed to understand right away that I would not be there in time for the first round, and you did not make a fuss when the facilitator asked for a partner. I also appreciate that you did not mention the delay repeatedly or turn it into a bigger issue than it needed to be. That made the situation easier to carry, even though I was still tired from the journey. Please know the help was noticed, even if I did not have the right words at the time. I hope the rest of the day went smoothly for you, and that the next gathering is a calm one.

I also came away feeling more confident about joining the next part, since your steadiness helped me settle in and remember details that mattered.

Best regards,
